description: Decode edge, plain text: a standard Messages response body crosses anthropic/messages -> canonical chat.response losslessly — the `text` content block becomes a PartText on a `model`-role turn (wire `assistant`, normalized once), stop_reason `end_turn` becomes the two-lane FinishInfo (reason `complete`, native verbatim), usage maps onto the disjoint Consumption buckets (input/output/cached/anthropic.cache_write — Anthropic's input_tokens EXCLUDES cache reads and writes, so the buckets are disjoint on the wire and total_tokens stays a plain sum), and the envelope identity decodes typed: `id` as an interface-scoped ProviderRef (kind response_id — crossing another (provider, interface) is UNSUPPORTED-and-reported, §2.4), `model` as the echo (this wire carries no creation timestamp). The `raw` lane is the untouched wire body, verbatim; a `stop_sequence: null` surfaces nothing. Synthetic, wire-accurate, hand-authored against Message / TextBlock / Usage (ocai-anthropic messages/wire.py).
